items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: I'd know them all of them once by then... I'd wait for them for about 18 years... I'd know them all of them.

ctx.x: They had to play your voice.

And Manmoretti would be a whole lot like that, too. They always had all good reading men. But they were all good musicians from downtown, those Creole people. I knew them all because I worked in the country grocery in Jefferson, Paris. And it was about a mile and a quarter out of the city limit. And they used to hire those fellows. They played fumes and all like that and parades and everything. Well, I knew all those old musicians' names from Wike and that Stewart. I had to stop there to get where they was going,…
But did they have any brass bands that just played by head uptown when you were a little boy?
